visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and professional makeup wears a dark brown v-neck shirt. She stands against a minimalist off-white background with a warm circular lamp visible. She gestures with both hands, palms facing the camera, while maintaining eye contact and a friendly smile. (2) The character puts on a black lace headband with a character bow. She uses a large white cleansing sheet to wipe her lips, eyes, and cheeks, removing makeup in real-time. She demonstrates the product's size by holding it over her entire face, showing its large dimensions. (3) A split-screen visual comparison appears, labeled "Before" and "After." The top half shows her with full makeup, and the bottom half shows her skin completely clean and radiant. She touches her cheek with her hand to emphasize the soft, hydrated texture of her bare skin. (4) Close-up shots of multiple Bifesta cleansing sheet packages in yellow, blue, pink, and green colors are arranged on a surface. The camera pans across the various functional types, highlighting the "Brightup" and "Moist" versions. Text overlays provide additional product details. (5) The woman holds a blue pack of Bifesta cleansing sheets towards the camera, pointing at the label with her finger. She continues speaking enthusiastically, with promotional text at the top detailing price and dates. The background remains consistent as she concludes her presentation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo pop background music with a clear electronic beat begins immediately. A young woman's voice, characterized by a bright, friendly tone and clear articulation, narrates the introduction. The vocal pitch is moderately high, suggesting excitement and engagement with the viewer. (2) A distinct mechanical click and plastic rustling sound occur as a lid is opened and a cleansing sheet is pulled out. The BGM continues without interruption, serving as a steady rhythmic foundation while the narration explains the specific use cases for the product in a conversational style. (3) The vocal delivery becomes more descriptive, highlighting ingredients like lactic acid. The background music remains consistent in volume and energy. No other environmental noise is audible, suggesting a controlled studio environment with high signal-to-noise ratio and professional-grade vocal clarity. (4) The speaker's pace increases slightly as she lists different product variations. The BGM maintains its catchy, positive mood. Final promotional details are delivered with a persuasive, authoritative yet warm tone. The audio track ends with a clean fade-out of the music.
